chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah and 'Abd Allah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother 'Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
'Ali ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام passed away when he was fifty-seven years old, in the year ninety-five. He lived for thirty-five years after al-Husayn عليه السلام.

key_terms.قُبِضَ: passed away; a reverential expression for death

ai.seo_question: When did Imam 'Ali ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام pass away, and how old was he?
ai.summary: This hadith records the age and year of the passing of Imam 'Ali ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام. It also states how many years he lived after Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام, preserving a concise biographical detail within the hadith tradition.

en.hubeali:
Sa’d Bin Abdullah and Abdullah Bin Ja’far Al Humeyri, from Ibrahim Bin Mahziyar, from his brother Ali Bin Mahziyar, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> passed away and he<sup>asws</sup> was fifty-seven years old, during the year ninety-five (A.H.). He<sup>asws</sup> lived after Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> for thirty five years’.
en.sarwar: 6. Sa‘d ibn ‘Abdallah and ‘Abdallah ibn Ja‘far al-Himyari have narrated from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar from his brother, Ali ibn Mahziyar from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Muhammad ibn Sinan from ibn Muskan from abu Basir from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.
“Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s.) passed away at the age of fifty seven in the year ninety five. He lived for thirty five years after al-Husayn (a.s.).”
